title: Base Power company performance, April-September 2026
body:
Fleet installed homes reached 18420 in September 2026, up from 16905 in April 2026.
Fleet energy capacity was 842 MWh in September 2026, and the average member battery was 45.7 kWh.
Fleet availability was 98.4 percent in September 2026, and 640 installations were completed that month.

title: Base Power quarterly performance, 2020 Q1 through 2026 Q3

Quarter-end installed homes were 820 in 2020 Q1, 1240 in 2020, 2180 in 2021, 3640 in 2022, 6150 in 2023, 9820 in 2024, 15020 in 2025, and 18420 in 2026 Q3.
Fleet energy capacity at quarter end was 31 MWh in 2020 Q1 and 842 MWh in 2026 Q3.
2020 quarter-end homes: Q1 820, Q2 960, Q3 1105, Q4 1240. Grid services revenue: Q1 $0.42 million, Q2 $0.51 million, Q3 $0.63 million, Q4 $0.78 million.
2021 quarter-end homes: Q1 1420, Q2 1640, Q3 1900, Q4 2180. Grid services revenue: Q1 $0.95 million, Q2 $1.12 million, Q3 $1.34 million, Q4 $1.58 million.
2022 quarter-end homes: Q1 2480, Q2 2820, Q3 3210, Q4 3640. Grid services revenue: Q1 $1.85 million, Q2 $2.10 million, Q3 $2.42 million, Q4 $2.78 million.
2023 quarter-end homes: Q1 4180, Q2 4780, Q3 5420, Q4 6150. Grid services revenue: Q1 $3.20 million, Q2 $3.65 million, Q3 $4.15 million, Q4 $4.70 million.
2024 quarter-end homes: Q1 6920, Q2 7780, Q3 8760, Q4 9820. Grid services revenue: Q1 $5.35 million, Q2 $6.05 million, Q3 $6.80 million, Q4 $7.60 million.
